textbookBox.concept: Measurement gives numbers so everyone can agree. Long ago people used a hand span or a foot, but those differ from person to person. So we use standard units, the same for everyone.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: Measurement gives numbers so everyone can agree. Long ago people used a hand span or a foot, but those differ from person to person. So we use standard units, the same for everyone.
beats.speakEn: Measurement gives numbers so everyone can agree. Long ago people used a hand span or a foot, but those differ from person to person. So we use standard units, the same for everyone.

beats.en: The standard unit of length in the SI system is the metre. Smaller lengths use the centimetre and millimetre. Long distances use the kilometre. 1 metre equals 100 centimetres. 1 centimetre equals 10 millimetres.
beats.speakEn: The standard unit of length in the SI system is the metre. Smaller lengths use the centimetre and millimetre. Long distances use the kilometre. 1 metre equals 100 centimetres. 1 centimetre equals 10 millimetres.

textbookBox.concept: Straight line motion is movement along a line, such as a car on a straight road. Circular motion is movement around a fixed point, such as a point on a fan blade.
